solution.title: Epic Hyperdrive & Hyperspace Client Deployment & Lifecycle Management with Microsoft Intune

products.name: Epic Hyperdrive & Hyperspace Client Deployment & Lifecycle Management with Microsoft Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Package, deploy, ring, validate, and retire the Epic clinical client (Hyperdrive + legacy Hyperspace) across every clinical endpoint with Microsoft Intune — version-pinned to your Epic environment, rolled out pilot-first, and kept current through supersedence. Self-guided, tested.
products.description:
Deploy the Epic client to every clinical endpoint — and keep it current — without drift

Epic client rollouts go wrong in predictable ways: Hyperdrive/Hyperspace version drift across the fleet, hand-built workstations and WOWs, installs that break at go-live, and old versions that never get cleanly retired. This solution makes the Epic client a managed, version-pinned Win32 app in Microsoft Intune: packaged with proper detection, rolled out through pilot and broad deployment rings, validated at every gate, upgraded via supersedence, and cleanly retired — across clinical workstations, WOWs, and exam-room PCs. (Epic-specific installer and version values come from your Epic Technical Services team / UserWeb; this package owns the Intune packaging, ring, validation, and lifecycle mechanics.)

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Hyperdrive/Hyperspace client model, version pinning, rings, and the lifecycle (package → pilot → broad → supersede → retire).
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune licensing, Win32 Content Prep Tool, the Epic installer from your Epic TS/UserWeb, target OS, co-management, ring device groups, detection strategy, test device, change control) with how to verify and how to implement it if missing, plus the category Global Requirements.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered, full-path steps: build the .intunewin with named detection rules, create pilot/broad device groups, assign the pilot ring, validate, broad-deploy, then upgrade via supersedence and cleanly retire old versions.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — installed-version discovery, per-device validation, fleet rollout/version report, safe install/uninstall remediation, and a deployment-ring group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with clear pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for ringed clinical rollouts.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The Epic client deployed and version-pinned across the entire clinical fleet, rolled out pilot-first, kept current through supersedence, and cleanly retired when versions change — managed end to end by your own team.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • EPICCLIENT-Discovery.ps1 — Inventories the installed Epic client (Hyperdrive/Hyperspace) version and health
    • EPICCLIENT-Remediation.ps1 — Safely re-triggers install/uninstall of the named Epic client app for a device
    • EPICCLIENT-Report.ps1 — Fleet rollout / version report for the Epic client (per-ring counts, version spread) to CSV
    • EPICCLIENT-Set-DeploymentRings.ps1 — Creates the pilot/broad Entra device groups and (optionally) wires ring assignments via Graph
    • EPICCLIENT-Validation.ps1 — Confirms a device has the target Epic client version and launch prerequisites

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
